# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Quin Kolinstuten, lu til Anawee U ko kolintwhu lu que ks soohum U que ks putenem. Ku yes konkonstinum yetilwha lu ye til eas s.hopt U jasyoyit, U ye til eas konquint U jas s.koyoleewhu.
Tat suewet wes olkosheetums oopen es olkosheetwhu lu es yapastenee. Lu ta epl chinaks Kolinstuten, e.chimish Anawee.
